description: A private set of photos for one client. Its page is a Site Builder page with the passcode feature on. Large versions are watermarked by this schema until the client has paid.

id.label: ID
id.help: Made from the title. The client's page points at this ID.

title.label: Client Name
title.help: The name at the top of the page, e.g. Mara and Theo.

session.label: Session
session.help: What and when, e.g. Golden Hour Session, September 2026.

note.label: Note to the Client
note.help: A short personal note at the top of the gallery.

gallery.label: Photographs
gallery.help: Drag this client's photos here. Large versions are watermarked automatically.

updated.label: Updated
updated.help: Set automatically when the object is saved.

created.label: Created
created.help: Set automatically when the object is created.

formgrid:
title id
session session
note note
gallery gallery
updated created
